audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and the missing-interactions brief flags that Galio's Colossal Smash (P) auto-attack reset — his combo's actual opener — is never mentioned as the tell to watch.
audit.why: The field just says 'his dash knockup' with no real number, and misses that Galio's all-in starts with a passive-empowered auto (a visible wind-up) before Justice Punch ever comes out.
audit.corrected: Cite Justice Punch (E) cd 11/10/9/8/7s directly, and add that Colossal Smash (P) empowered auto is the actual tell that opens his combo.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Battle Dance banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Justice Punch (E) is 11/10/9/8/7s — his only gap-close, and he has no engage while it's down. - His combo actually opens with Colossal Smash (P), an empowered auto wind-up — that's your cue to back off, not the E cast itself. - Keep E Battle Dance banked for his taunt window.

edits.before: Q the pair for the heal, W the window, E home — the trade paid twice and answered once.
edits.after: Charm through his shield window: land R when Hero's Entrance channel ends or his shield has already dropped — casting it first just burns your only lockdown on a shielded target.

edits.before: Entrancing into a banked disengage — the bird that flies into tornadoes writes the highlight for the other team.
edits.after: Don't commit while Justice Punch and Flash are both up — Colossal Smash's empowered auto queues bonus damage into the trade before you see the knockup coming.
